overview.text: The Indian Institute of Technology Hyderabad (IITH) invites bids for a web-based Enterprise Resource Planning (ERP) solution to automate its Academic and Administrative functions. The tender utilizes a Quality Cum Cost Based Selection (QCBS) scheme with 70% technical weightage and requires bidders to submit detailed proposals including Proof of Concept demonstrations.

scope.text: The solution must automate Academic and Administrative functions including Finance & Accounts, Stores & Purchases, Asset Management, HRM & Payroll, Estate Management, Project Management, and Asset Maintenance.

Implementation involves porting or integrating data from existing systems, developing Core and Other Modules, and providing Application Maintenance & Enhancement Services (AMES) for three years post-warranty.
Technical evaluation requires a presentation covering Bidder Profile, Project Plan, Functional Mapping, Non-Functional Capabilities, Case Studies, and Proof of Concept (POC) demonstrations.
The project timeline mandates Core Module completion within 15 months and Other Modules within 18 months from the date of agreement signing.

key_requirements.text: Bidders must submit specific PDF responses for Parts A through E of the Technical Evaluation and provide reference checks for data migration tools.
Only bidders scoring a minimum of 60% in Parts A to E are invited for Part F POC demonstrations.
A Performance Bank Guarantee (PBG) of 3% of the contract price must be furnished within 15 days, and a Service Level Agreement (SLA) must be executed.
Bidders must declare no previous transgression regarding corrupt practices within the last three years and provide proof of signature identification.

eligibility.text: The Implementing Agency must have at least 5 years of experience as an ERP solution providing agency and be registered with the Tax Department.
Part A evaluation requires a minimum score of 6 marks out of 10 to meet technical eligibility thresholds.
Bidders must declare no previous transgression regarding corrupt practices with any Public Sector Enterprise or Government Department in India within the last three years.

important_dates.text: Bid Submission Close Date is 15 Mar 2021 at 1700 hrs.
Opening of Technical Bids (Envelope 'A') is scheduled for 16 Mar 2021 at 1100 hrs.
The tender and price remain valid for six calendar months from the date of submission.
Security Deposit must be deposited by way of Bank Guarantee within 15 days of signing the Contract.

commercial_requirements.text: Services are billed on a Time & Material (T&M) basis, with prices quoted in Indian Rupees inclusive of all taxes and support costs.
Payment milestones include releases upon Architecture completion, CRP demos, cross-functional integration, beta testing, UAT approval, and post-warranty periods.
Liquidated Damages will be levied at 1% per month subject to a maximum of 10% on the total contract value for non-fulfilment of delivery schedules.

important_conditions.text: Confidentiality and non-disclosure obligations apply; the Implementing Agency must not use disclosed data for third-party services.
Any subcontracting activity requires prior approval from IITH, and the IA is solely responsible for deficiencies in subcontracted modules.
Disputes shall be resolved by arbitration under the Arbitration and Conciliation Act, 1996, with proceedings held in Hyderabad/Sangareddy.
